overview: Nanking telegram reports Armstrong will supply his firm's services but not personally reside in Taiwan; Yen will seek another adviser, though Stuart doubts anyone will accept, since Americans know too little about Taiwan; a transfer sheet reclassifies a related telegram.

people.name: Stillman
people.role: Participant in discussions concerning engineering advisory services for Taiwan; surname uncertain because of OCR

people.name: Armstrong
people.role: American consultant associated with a firm offering engineering services for Taiwan

people.name: Wei Tao-ming
people.role: Taiwanese provincial leader seeking a personal engineering adviser

people.name: Yen Chia-kan
people.role: Chinese official asked to help locate a qualified American adviser

subfiles.title: Telegram from Stuart on recruiting an engineering adviser for Taiwan
subfiles.from: J. Leighton Stuart, U.S. Embassy, Nanking
subfiles.about: Reports discussions about securing either a consulting firm or a resident American engineering adviser for Wei Tao-ming in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: Embassy reports Taiwan needs a competent firm, not just a personal adviser; Armstrong's firm will help but he won't personally relocate there, and Yen will seek another American, though doubts remain anyone will accept prolonged Taiwan residence.

subfiles.title: Transfer sheet for Telegram No. 1564
subfiles.from: Department of State, Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.about: Records the reclassification of correspondence dated August 24, 1948, from the engineering-adviser file to a general Japan file.
subfiles.summary: Transfer sheet moves August 1948 Telegram No. 1564 from file 894.64A to file 800.504 Japan.

interest: Shows postwar difficulty recruiting an American engineering adviser for Taiwan, and Taiwan-related filing under a Japan decimal heading.
